instructions: Translate the approved Verdant Growth Nursery target into a 26 x 10 x 18 inch presentation-only model. Build an asymmetrical braided trunk, four clearly separated tiers of individually curved and thick leaves, dark plum undersides, several large ochre hanging seed pods, a raised rear work platform, and an open front approach with a small potting surface and ladder. Keep foliage leaves physically shaped rather than planes, avoid a closed canopy roof and sphere crown, and keep the entrance/work bay visible at 64 inches. Do not add collision, navigation, selection, work, or growth behavior.
material_method: Broad solid natural greens, contrasting plum undersides, warm living rootwood, and ochre seed pods carry the faction read at settlement distance; roughness variation separates organic materials at close view.
tool: Blender procedural component authoring with joined GLB mesh and solid PBR materials.
